requirements.note: Archetype admission is source-neutral and needs no candidate output; proved by tests/integration/environment.test.ts.

Preregistration -> measured acquisition -> byte freeze -> package verification -> exact package manifest is enforced by the workspace and proved by the CLI e2e; a skipped stage refuses with GRAPH_CLOSURE_MISSING_ROLE.
The generic step engine drives all 14 intents through planned/started/succeeded/failed/unsupported/outcome-frozen with one identical lifecycle shape.
`unsupported` is a first-class step outcome for every intent and is retained in the output manifest. The subject_unsupported finding is slice 6.
Mutation intent, receipt and compensation are host-adjudicated; an undeclared or unreconciled mutation refuses.
Output freezes before any reveal and the engine refuses to execute a step after one. Truth reveal itself is slice 6.
Validity, journey, domain and generic-index producers ship in packages/core/src/evaluation; the four planes stay separate and no scalar combines them.

Data-only DSL only under ERL2-OQ-004. A pack is closed data with no code, I/O, clock, randomness, validity or threshold member; tests/architecture/evaluationBoundary.test.ts proves that from the schema.
AssistanceEventV1 is a frozen contract with its conditionals; the journey engine emits it in slice 5 when a human or agent actor exists.
A failed or unsupported acquisition/verification finalizes with a journey result and DomainResultNotApplicableV1; no functional scoring is invented and functional truth stays sealed.

Split visible step / age-x25519 encrypted expectation / commitment, with a structural field guard on the subject side. Canary scanning covers three of the eight design-named surfaces with a production-path regression and a load-bearing negative control each (mounted_file, lab_telemetry, subject_output_prefill); adapter_request is live but shadowed by the mounted-file scan and is not counted; the remaining four are named in PENDING_ORACLE_SCAN_SURFACES and are not scanned. The earlier claim of all eight was wrong (ADR-ERL2-032, review Slice 6.5B P2).
Replay and live envelopes, mode admissibility and translation totality are implemented and tested. The adapter that produces a real translated tree is slice 5.
Phase-specific closed request contracts plus assertRequestAncestry and the subject-side oracle field guard.
Both early terminals are reachable: a verified package can terminate pre-environment, and a failed acquisition freezes exactly one invalid record after bounded cleanup. Both verify offline.
Replay is refused outside development tier; live equivalence cannot be reported as byte equality.

Frontier derivation, receipt-backed per-action cleanup and the verifier's bypass refusal are covered end to end. ADR-ERL2-027 extends the discipline from the emergency branch to every invalid environment terminal and adds cleanup-residue-probe/v1 (ERL2-C-158), the independent post-cleanup observation that makes a fabricated empty residue and an unauthorized destruction offline-detectable: tests/adversarial/invalidCleanupDiscipline.test.ts, tests/integration/cleanupDerivation.test.ts.
Verified on macOS arm64 in this session; the Linux amd64 lane is wired in .github/workflows/pr.yml and runs on CI.

Enforced on the local-process profile: separate process, process-tree termination, deadline, frame bounds, environment allowlist, single writable output, read-only-mount tamper detection, capability/credential/egress adjudication. Kernel-level controls (read-only rootfs, non-root uid, capability drop, seccomp, cgroup limits, network namespace, socket block) are reported unsupported_on_this_host; the container profile is disabled with no qualified adapter substrate.

ERL2-OQ-001 unresolved: every privileged capability is denied with ADAPTER_PRIVILEGED_OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED and the denial is recorded in AdapterCapabilityGrantV1. No shell capability exists in the enum at all. Unprivileged subject operations only.
Run-scoped resource identity, allocator isolation and zero-residue teardown are implemented and tested on the fake driver; a live two-tenant substrate needs ERL2-OQ-005.
The required clean-greenfield control is admitted and repeatable. The eleven constrained/brownfield archetypes are slice 10 work, blocked on ERL2-OQ-002.
Idempotency, conflict detection, driver mutation/compensation receipts and step-level attempt records exist; the adapter compensation ledger is slice 5.

open_questions.fail_closed: data-only declarative pack DSL; no executable pack module and no pack runtime to sandbox

open_questions.decision: OpenTelemetry Demo release and image digest lock
open_questions.fail_closed: an unqualified lock still yields a disabled Compose driver; the fake driver remains the default and is never displaced. At run time an expected container name is not ownership (all three com.erl2/compose labels must carry this run's exact values and the running image must resolve through Docker to the locked service/platform digest, in both directions, or the graph is refused); a retained endpoint record is not an egress grant (every field is revalidated against the run id and Docker is re-observed for the exact container, its labels, a running state, the locked endpoint image by the same two-legged rule, and the binding 8090/tcp on 127.0.0.1 at exactly the recorded host port, and loopbackEgressPolicy independently refuses any host but 127.0.0.1 and any non-host port); the rendered Compose configuration publishes exactly one host port, quote 8090/tcp on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 binding, with the collector's 4317/4318 not published at all; and --verify writes nothing under version control.
open_questions.note: A two-service subset of OpenTelemetry Demo 3.0.0 (quote + otel-collector) is pinned by archive SHA-256, source commit, per-platform image digests for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, five applied config hashes, an SBOM and a provenance record; the Compose driver is enabled by it and proven against a live daemon. The lock is signed by the repo-derivable development environment-governor key, so this is a self-qualification: no independent-qualification claim follows, and the claim ceiling is unchanged (development tier and non-blind selection still cap at T1 under ERL2-OQ-007). REQUIRED_PLATFORMS was corrected from linux/amd64 + darwin/arm64 to linux/amd64 + linux/arm64; darwin/arm64 is not an image manifest platform. Telemetry: a Compose run now retains the attributable-telemetry observation (attributable-telemetry-observation/v1, ADR-ERL2-033) — counts, the exact collector log lines they derive from, and the Docker-verified container identity, frozen before teardown_started — and an offline bundle attests received telemetry exactly that far. The evidence window is untouched: the observation post-dates the realized cutoff, the service-metric source is still complete on collector OTLP pipeline readiness, and every source snapshot in this archetype still freezes records: 0 — pipeline readiness is reachability of the metric path, not the receipt of a service metric. provenance.json is bound to the lock by content on their shared fields, not by hash, because SubstrateLockV1 has no provenance-hash field.
open_questions.deferred_to_first_qualiber_integration_p: Discharged 2026-08-06 by the first Qualiber integration package (ADR-ERL2-033, ledger docs/ledger/qualiber-integration-telemetry.md). The attributable-telemetry observation is retained into the run's evidence (frozen before teardown_started, produced on that event so the lifecycle chain proves the collector was read while the containers lived) and gated on where the retained bytes declare it obtainable: driver_kind compose, an archetype declaring a metric evidence source, and a succeeded exercise step outcome. Enforcement points: the producer's attributable-telemetry-retained validity gate (required on every environment terminal, vacuous where undeclared), and the offline verifier's deriveAttributableTelemetry, which re-derives the declaration predicate and recomputes every count from the retained log excerpt's bytes (refusals ENV_TELEMETRY_OBSERVATION_MISSING, ENV_TELEMETRY_NOT_ATTRIBUTED, ENV_TELEMETRY_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH). docs/claims/permitted-claims.md now permits the retained-telemetry statement at exactly that width; claims inside the evidence window remain forbidden and the ceiling is unchanged at T1.

open_questions.decision: container or disposable-VM substrate qualified for opaque subjects
open_questions.deadline: before slice 7 executes an opaque package
open_questions.fail_closed: substrate qualified with twenty observed controls against a Node-capable, digest-pinned image, and a container-backed launcher now starts adapters inside it — but the lock and probe manifest are development-signed, so the qualification is self-reported. Only a trusted_reference subject may use the container profile; every opaque-private or third-party subject is refused under it by an explicit subject-trust gate, and erl2 doctor still reports locally_observed_unauthenticated
open_questions.note: ADR-ERL2-034 (2026-08-07) closes gate 2 only. The runtime image changed to erl2-adapter-runtime@sha256:cc3808ff40b19dd58f341019b0ddd827402346c657e05b1d7e95be90044a4440, built from node@sha256:c610fcdf (node:22-alpine) by environments/isolation/runtime-image/Dockerfile, because the alpine substrate ADR-ERL2-017 qualified has no Node runtime and cannot host the adapter protocol; the twenty controls were re-observed against the new image and the alpine evidence is superseded, not reused. node:22-alpine itself failed no-ambient-home-directory (it creates /home/node) and the image was changed rather than the probe — the probe-suite digest is unchanged. ADAPTER-CERT-V1 passes under the container profile against reference-correct, meeting the §5.5 exit gate ADR-ERL2-017 decision 4 recorded as never met. What remains is gate 1b: a pinned, verifier-controlled qualification authority signing the lock and the probe-signing manifest. The claim ceiling is unchanged at T1.

normative_conflicts.summary: Design v2 §16.2 lists TrustPolicyManifestV1, ProductSafeSignerInventoryV1 and TrustVerificationReportV1 as retained byte-compatible, but V2 requires signer roles, terminal variants and schema identities those contracts cannot express.

slices.title: Integrity, lifecycle, selection, trust and offline-verification kernel
Environment archetypes and clean ecosystem
slices.exit_gate: Fake driver satisfies the full EnvironmentDriver suite; clean environment reaches a stable baseline twice with identical fingerprints; teardown leaves zero applicable residue; ERL2-OQ-005 unresolved so the Compose driver stays disabled and the plan stays on the fake driver (implementation plan §9.4).

slices.title: Journey, acquisition, blind selection and capture
slices.exit_gate: Acquisition reaches frozen subject output through the CLI; the selection chain verifies independently; journey closure is derived from lifecycle events rather than producer arrays; both early terminals verify offline; no judge canary reaches subject-visible state. Held-out and blind execution stay refused under ERL2-OQ-007, Compose stays disabled under ERL2-OQ-005, and the subject is the development-only fake port because slice 5 owns the adapter host.

slices.title: Adapter SDK, sandbox host and reference subjects
slices.exit_gate: Correct and limited reference adapters certify under ADAPTER-CERT-V1 and drive the journey out of process through the public subject-adapter/v1 protocol; core owns the executable identity, protocol, frame bounds, deadline, process-tree termination, environment allowlist, mounts, output, diagnostics, capability, credential, egress and mutation boundaries it actually enforces; 23 hostile adapter fixtures each yield a typed adapter or Lab outcome and never a subject defect; removing every adapter package leaves core green. ERL2-OQ-001 unresolved so every privileged capability is refused, and the container sandbox profile is disabled with no qualified adapter substrate, so kernel-level isolation is reported unsupported rather than claimed.

slices.title: Generic evaluation, terminal closure and finalization
slices.exit_gate: The finding union is closed and every prohibited crossover refuses; the evaluation pack DSL is data-only and certified; deterministic Lab-owned metrics measure the journey and domain planes; correct, limited, misleading and inconclusive reference subjects produce different typed outcomes; fabricated citations are detected by set membership against the frozen canonical envelope; journey and exactly one domain result join before cleanup; validity reads only Lab-owned gates; invalid validity cannot enter the generic index; a valid pre-environment terminal finalizes and its public bundle verifies offline in a fresh process; invalid records verify offline and produce no bundle. The *environment* valid terminal is not reachable end to end because the selection, provisioning and observation CLI commands belong to the slice 3/4 environment branch, which has not shipped; its contracts, closure roles and refusals exist and are exercised, but no environment run record, attestation or bundle is produced by a real run.
